title: Tracking temporary workaround: `_to_variant` for MSVC
body:
### Tested versions

Since 34fa0bf3ec531cd0545200eaabe80af04c8de127.

### System information

Only applicable to MSVC.

### Issue description

This issue is a call for someone using MSVC to reproduce an MSVC bug we encountered in the Godot codebase, and to create a Minimum Reproducible Project to [report to the MSVC team](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/cpp/report). If you plan to take on this task, please comment on the issue so that we avoid accidentally spamming the team with multiple reports.

Commit 34fa0bf3ec531cd0545200eaabe80af04c8de127 has introduced a temporary workaround for an MSVC bug. It was described in more detail in #100426 and in the relevant code (generating `gdvirtual.gen.inc`):

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fafc07335bdecacd96b548c4119fbe1f47ee5866/core/object/make_virtuals.py#L203-L232

In short, we have decided to merge the workaround, and try to [create an MRP](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/100426#discussion_r1886379331) to report to the MSVC developers. 
Such an MRP does not exist yet.


### Steps to reproduce

Here's what I know about the MSVC bug:

It is triggered by the `Variant(arg1)` etc. calls of e.g. `GDVIRTUAL3_REQUIRED` against e.g. `GDExtensionPtr<X>`. In this specific configuration, MSVC forgets about the `.operator Variant()` conversion offered by `GDExtensionPtr` and fails to resolve the call (see [this workflow run](https://github.com/Ivorforce/godot/actions/runs/12319310896/job/34386081561)), e.g.:

```
Error: .\servers/audio/audio_effect.h(43): error C2440: '<function-style-cast>': cannot convert from 'GDExtensionPtr<AudioFrame>' to 'Variant'
.\servers/audio/audio_effect.h(43): note: 'Variant::Variant': ambiguous call to overloaded function
.\core/variant/variant.h(825): note: could be 'Variant::Variant(const Variant &)'
.\core/variant/variant.h(826): note: or       'Variant::Variant(Variant &&)'
.\core/variant/variant.h(455): note: or       'Variant::Variant(bool)'
.\servers/audio/audio_effect.h(43): note: while trying to match the argument list '(GDExtensionPtr<AudioFrame>)'
scons: *** [platform\windows\display_server_windows.windows.template_release.x86_64.obj] Error 2
```

It should be possible to reproduce this bug reliably on Godot `master` by just removing the MSVC workaround, by replacing this line:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fafc07335bdecacd96b548c4119fbe1f47ee5866/core/object/make_virtuals.py#L130

with

```c++
        callsiargs += f"Variant(arg{i + 1})"
```

If it is not reproducible, we should be able to remove the workaround as-is :^)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
